text:
Priya Rao: Hey team — I've started walking through BigCorp's SIG. They want question-by-question evidence, but are asking for a single zip with itemized files and an index. Can someone point me to the latest artifacts for encryption-at-rest, KMS rotation, and key access controls?
Jordan Lee: I uploaded the encryption artifact and key rotation policy last week to the secure bucket. Path: `s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/crypto/` — files: `enc-at-rest.pdf`, `kms-rotation-2025.pdf`, `kms-access-list.csv`.
Sam O'Neill: Note: the `kms-access-list.csv` contains IAM ARNs with role mappings. We need to scrub non-customer-visible emails before sending. @Priya do you want me to produce a redacted copy and a mapping doc? :eyes:
Priya Rao: Yes please — BigCorp legal insisted on PII-free bundles. If you can also produce a short MD5 manifest so they can verify integrity, that would be perfect.
Ari Gomez: FYI, for the network controls questions they also asked for firewall rule export and subnet diagrams. Those are in Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/BigCorp+SIG+Network. I can export a PDF.
Jordan Lee: I'll pull the latest firewall rules and subnet diagram and add to `s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/network/`. Will include `network-rules.json` and `subnet-diagram.pdf`.
Sam O'Neill: Quick checklist for final bundle: `enc-at-rest.pdf` (redacted), `kms-rotation-2025.pdf`, `kms-access-list-redacted.csv`, `network-rules.json`, `subnet-diagram.pdf`, `service-account-roles.csv` (redacted), `manifest-md5.txt`, and an `index.csv` mapping each SIG question to the file name.
Priya Rao: Can we also add the control-owner affirmation note? BigCorp asked for a signed statement for SOC/SC-13 and IAM controls. Template is in `confluence/SEC/templates/control-affirmation.docx` — I'll fill and get it signed.
sec-bot: Reminder: Any artifact containing potential secrets must be uploaded to the secured bucket with `sse:kms` and the upload must include a sensitivity tag. See policy: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SEC/pages/Artifact+Upload+Policy
Ari Gomez: For timelines: I can export and upload network PDFs by EOD. Sam — can you do redaction + manifest by tomorrow morning? Jordan — after you copy the files over, can you set bucket ACL to `project-bigcorp-readonly` and grant access to the customer's portal account?
Jordan Lee: Yup — plan: upload now, run `aws s3 cp --recursive ./bigcorp_artifacts s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/ --sse aws:kms` then set bucket policy. I'll ping when done.
Sam O'Neill: I'll run redaction script: `python tools/redact_pii.py --input s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/crypto/ --output s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/crypto/redacted/` and then generate `manifest-md5.txt` from the redacted folder.
Priya Rao: Awesome. Once everything is uploaded, I'll assemble `bigcorp_sig_bundle_v1.zip` and attach the `index.csv` mapping SIG question numbers to evidence filenames. I'll upload the zip to the customer's secure portal and drop a link in this thread.
Jordan Lee: Uploaded network + crypto originals and set bucket policy. Files: `s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/crypto/enc-at-rest.pdf`, `s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/network/subnet-diagram.pdf`.
Sam O'Neill: Redacted copies uploaded and manifest generated. `s3://redwood-evidence/bigcorp/sig_v1/crypto/redacted/` contains `enc-at-rest_redacted.pdf`, `kms-access-list_redacted.csv`, `manifest-md5.txt`.
Priya Rao: Linking the pieces: I'll run the bundle and post the portal link in 30. Thanks all. :rocket:
Ari Gomez: One more ask from BigCorp — they want the exact Redwood version of the KMS integration (library + agent) that's running in their dedicated cluster. @Jordan can you include the `agent-version.txt` from `/opt/redwood/agent/VERSION` in the bundle?
Jordan Lee: On it. Dropping `agent-version.txt` into `/s3` now.
Priya Rao: Portal link: https://portal.bigcorp-secure.com/transfer/abc123 — bundle name `bigcorp_sig_bundle_v1.zip`. Sent to their security assessor with note about redacted fields and contact info.
Sam O'Neill: Confirmed they downloaded and requested one minor clarification on a role mapping. I'll prepare a one-pager showing how we map `redwood-admin` -> `redwood:kms-admin` for them.
Priya Rao: Great, let's close this once the one-pager is uploaded. I'll update the SIG response spreadsheet with `evidence_bundle: bigcorp_sig_bundle_v1.zip` and mark questions answered.
Jordan Lee: Closing loop — added bucket lifecycle tag and set object retention to 90 days as requested.
Priya Rao: Thanks team! :tada:
